newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville continues peak, off-peak power offers.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville continues peak, off-peak power offers.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer both peak and off-peak power for Wednesday pre-schedulings, with peak volumes limited to 500 megawatts (MW), the agency said Tuesday.

BPA again offered "market expansion" power at $9.00 per megawatt hour (MWH) during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST for energy only or Northwest deliveries, compared with a price of $9.50 for Tuesday pre-schedulings.

Wednesday firm power during off-peak hours was offered at $10.50 per MWh for all deliveries, down from $11.50. Peak power was offered at $17.00 (Northwest) and $18.00 (California-Oregon border), up 25 cents per MWh from Tuesday prices.
Prices for Wednesday non-firm power during off-peak hours were also raised slightly to $10.50-12.50 per MWh, while on-peak power was offered at $17.00-19.00 in the Northwest and $18.00-20.50 at COB.
